repair_finding.root_cause: Godot JSON.parse_string restores JSON numbers as TYPE_FLOAT. The original P2.8 codec emitted TYPE_INT values as untagged JSON numbers, so current_year, seed_count and other integer truth changed Variant type after restore. Canonical hashing distinguishes TYPE_INT from TYPE_FLOAT; deserialize_checkpoint therefore rejected its own freshly serialized checkpoint fail-closed.
repair_finding.direct_engine_probe: original int typeof=TYPE_INT(2); parsed int typeof=TYPE_FLOAT(3)
repair_finding.semantic_effect: world_hash and checkpoint_hash mismatch after first save/deserialize; Experiment.run returns empty before P2.8 result
repair_finding.repair: encode TYPE_INT as {__eco_type:Int,value:n} and restore with int(value)
